name: Qila

role.id: Kakak yang cerewet, sayang adik, dan punya jiwa pemimpin
role.en: A fussy but loving big sister with a leader's heart

artNotes: Direction: 03 Bold Flat Pop WITH hijab (manager's pick 2026-11-12 — final canon; the no-hijab exploration in public/mockups/03-bold-flat-pop.html stays in the gallery only). Art: hijab is ALWAYS rendered, in every scene — bold-flat rounded hood + shoulder-drape silhouette, thick 3.5-4px ink outline #262238, coral #FF5D5D hood with a sunflower #FFC53D star-clip accent; teal #19B3A6 dress with sun hem band + coral batik dots; skin #E8A66C; big glint eyes; hard offset shadows, saturated flat fills, no gradients. Expression chips: 'cerewet-face' (rect nag-mouth + raised nag brows), 'warm-leader' (open leader smile + confident brows), 'gentle' (soft closed smile + relaxed brows, hand-on-heart energy). Voice/pacing: firm-but-warm kakak; quicker, clipped lines when cerewet; she catches herself, softens and slows in leader/gentle beats; never mean or shouty. Fictional character: no surname, no photos, no real age.
